title: Mij at play in Basra
body:
Read the passage and answer the question that follows.

Very soon after his arrival, Mij would follow Maxwell without a lead and come when his name was called. He spent most of his time in play. For hours he would shuffle a rubber ball round the room like a four-footed soccer player, using all four feet to dribble it, and with a powerful flick of the neck he could throw it to a surprising height and distance. But Maxwell says the real play of an otter is when he lies on his back and juggles with small objects between his paws. Marbles were Mij's favourite toys for this pastime: lying on his back, he would roll two or more of them up and down his wide, flat belly without ever dropping one to the floor.
